The chart confirms a resolution-dependent timing/amplitude bias: the SIR spike peaks sharper and earlier at 1° than at 4°, which would skew uncertainty bands if applied directly. To fix this, I'll compute each member's timing/amplitude deviation relative to the 4° reference and apply it to the converged 1° reference, keeping the raw 4° ensemble as a separate line.
